title: Print Uniform Chip Height
description: All chips in print/tex (chapter, section, subsection, paragraph, navbar, footer) must share the same height and same padding/spacing as the navbar chip. Currently chapter/section/etc. heading chips are taller than the navbar chip. Normalize chip height across print/tex/semio-window.sty and semio-core.sty to the navbar chip's height.
summary:
Root cause was a TeX dimexpr digit-concatenation bug: writing `N\semio@chrome@padding` (or `N\semio@spacing@unit` etc.) where the macro expands to text like "0.2em" made TeX's number scanner concatenate the coefficient with the leading digits of the expansion (e.g. `2\semio@chrome@padding` became the dimension "20.2em" instead of "0.4em"). This was previously masked in \semio@chrome@titlebar@height (a raw em-text macro re-evaluated per call site) but surfaced badly once titlebar height was computed once via \semio@chrome@dims@compute using the same buggy pattern, and the same bug was already present in the window/image content-height and table-height dimexpr calculations, causing chapter/section/paragraph/window/figure heading chips to balloon far past their intended single-row height instead of matching the navbar chip.
Fixed \semio@chrome@dims@compute in print/tex/semio-window.sty to compute \semio@chrome@titlebar@height once as an absolute length (font-body + padding + padding + hairline + hairline, added term-by-term instead of via coefficient) inside a \normalfont group, exactly mirroring the existing \semio@chrome@row@height computation used by the navbar/footer chips — so all "cap"-based chips (chapter/section/subsection headings, muted paragraph tabs, window title tabs) now resolve to the same absolute height as the navbar chip regardless of the font context they're invoked from (previously chapter/section chips inflated to the size of the surrounding \Huge/\Large sectioning font).
Fixed the same digit-concatenation bug at the other 3 call sites in print/tex/semio-window.sty (window textfit target height, image target height/width) and 1 in print/tex/semio-components.sty (arbeitsprobe cover image height), plus 2 in print/tex/semio-table.sty (table header/body row height), replacing `N\macro` coefficients with explicit repeated addition.
Verified by rendering report/zwischenbericht templates to PNG (via pdfjs+canvas) before and after: chapter ("Introduction"/"1"), section ("Architecture"/"1.1"), subsection, paragraph, window-title, figure/photo/image-caption, and cover-field chips all now render as compact single-line bars matching the navbar chip height, instead of tall column-spanning blocks. Rebuilt all templates (report, zwischenbericht, forschungsbericht, kompaktbericht, paper, flyer, light+dark) via `bun ./📜️script.ts build <template>` — all exit 0 with no new errors; report.pdf dropped from 12 to 6 pages since window/image boxes are no longer mis-sized.
